name: Royal Jousting Grounds
introDiscord:
A massive arena lies beyond the palace walls.

Broken lances, spectator boxes, banners, and stone tournament lanes
reveal what this place really was:

the kingdom's royal jousting grounds.

Shizuki's excitement is documented extensively.
introTwitch:
A massive arena lies beyond the palace walls.

Broken lances, spectator boxes, banners, and stone tournament lanes
reveal what this place really was:

the kingdom's royal jousting grounds.

Shizuki's excitement is documented extensively.

drowned-lists-approach.prompt: Royal Jousting Grounds opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A Drowned Duelist enters the tournament lane and salutes.

Apparently registration remains open.

right.message: A spectator box contains old prize Star Candies.

forward.message:
Shizuki's restorative sits beside a wooden lance.

'JOUSTING ATTEMPT ONE:

No horse.

No opponent.

Still fell over.

Training needed.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

drowned-lists-depths.prompt: Deeper within Royal Jousting Grounds, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A champion's prize chest contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Duelist challenges you beneath the arena banners.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's tournament scoreboard:

'SHIZUKI — 1 WIN

GLIMMER — disputed

WOODEN PRACTICE DUMMY — 0

VICTORY.'

drowned-lists-threshold.prompt: Near Tidal Tournament Floor, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A competitors' infirmary contains restorative supplies.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: An old champion's coffer contains Star Candies.

forward.message: A Drowned Duelist guards the championship floor.

bossPromptDiscord:
The spectator stands remain empty.

Still, the arena bells ring.

One armored champion enters the opposite side of the tournament floor.

Use /yes to enter the final royal match or /no to retire
with Shizuki's undefeated 1–0 record intact.
bossPromptTwitch:
The spectator stands remain empty.

Still, the arena bells ring.

One armored champion enters the opposite side of the tournament floor.

Use !yes to enter the final royal match or !no to retire
with Shizuki's undefeated 1–0 record intact.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Tidal Tournament Floor. The royal challenge will wait.

boss.revealText: Champion of the Last Court reveals itself!

completionText:
The champion bows.

The arena goes quiet.

Shizuki's scoreboard somehow now reads:

'SHIZUKI — still champion.'
